positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
• Created internal applications using ReactJS, JavaScript, NodeJS, and Boto3 SDK (Python). 
• Updated managed pipelines to run more efficiently
• Refactored existing applications to ensure they meet company compliance testing standards
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Node.js · React.js · JavaScript · Python · Amazon Dynamodb · User Interface Design · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Production Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Automated test environment creation with bash scripts, python, and AWS services (Lambda, ELB, ECS) decrease QA testing time frame.
• Engineered CI/CD Notification solution using AWS services (Step Functions, Lambda, CodePipeline, IAM) and Python which resulted in shorter development cycles
• Created SQL scripts to aid operations departments solve recurring customer support tickets utilizing the RDS AWS service.
positions.insights: Skills: Production Support · AWS CloudFormation · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · AWS Step Functions · Python · SQL · AWS Elastic Beanstalk · DevOps · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
• Wrote functional tests for multiple user stories using JUnit which increased code coverage and resulted in a decrease of 10%  in overall bugs reported.
• Utilized third party XML parsing libraries and clean architecture methodology to accomplish user requirements resulting in increased self-reported customer satisfaction of about 8%.
• Implemented Android UI using Android studio’s layout editor and custom coded components ensuring the project stayed on schedule and all customer-requested specs were implemented efficiently.
• Created automated UI tests using the espresso framework, catching potential customer impacting issues before they arose, avoiding a longer project timeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Android SDK · Kotlin · Android Development · Java · JUnit

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Integrated unit test using Microsoft’s unit testing framework in a website redesign project that allowed for 35% better code coverage.
• Redesigned a website feature using Javascript, and CSS which resulted in a cleaner looking user interface on mobile devices.
• Refactored content management system module with RazorScript and SQL for better maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · Xamarin · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Framework · JavaScript · CSS · User Experience (UX) · Bootstrap (Framework) · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Primary Application Developer that was responsible for mobile application design and
development utilizing Android Studio.

Met with stakeholders to determine application requirements.

Conducted design research, determined feasibility and presented findings.

Documented technical design specifications.

Developed code based on requirements and design specifications.

Conducted unit testing.

Participated in code reviews.

Worked as a part of an agile team (Scrum).

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Internship
positions.description:
Created a highly requested feature for Google Slides not yet in production

Designed, and developed test scenarios to ensure full test coverage while going through all phases of UAT testing.

Repaired a software production bug that caused an unexpected result for Google Docs users.

Worked with managers and colleagues to get clarification on feature requirements, then implemented solutions including code development and feature design.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Internship
positions.description:
Created and updated dashboard tools for the iOS Google Search App (IGSA).

Designed and developed the Startup Latency dashboard, displaying the latencies involved in the startup process for the IGSA. 

Refactored the Reliability dashboard as it was previously displaying data for old ways of measuring reliability statistics. The dashboard now shows up-to-date data on reliability statistics such as the daily percentages of successful session logs across all IGSA clients.

Developed Go scripts using Google specific libraries to collect and process client log data from the IGSA,  displaying this data in a dashboard for other Googlers to view and discover areas of improvement for the IGSA.
